text: Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through last Tuesday evening.
Sure. I got home from work about six-fifteen.
What did you do after you got home?
I changed clothes, heated leftovers, and watched the game on the couch.
My roommate was in their room on a video call. I said hi when I came in.
Did you leave again that night?
No. I stayed in until morning. I was in bed by eleven.
Phone calls or messages around nine?
I texted my sister goodnight around nine-thirty. That was it.
Anything else you think we should know about Tuesday?
Not really. It was an ordinary night.
